```odin
import fx "fire:fx"
```

Effects and filters, as units to run on stereo buffers (and nodes to put
in a graph): the eight filter models a synth voice has (`filter_render`),
and the effects a synth chains after its voices: chorus, a three-band
compressor, delay, distortion, EQ, a filter, flanger, phaser and reverb.
Each takes its settings as a plain struct and glides between renders,
so they can be modulated, and allocates nothing while it runs (the delay
lines are in its state, made with the effect).

```odin
state: fx.Distortion
p := fx.DISTORTION_DEFAULTS
p.drive_db = 12
fx.distortion_render(&state, &p, left, right, sample_rate)
```

## Constants

### CHAIN_ORDER

```odin
CHAIN_ORDER : [9]Effect : [len(Effect)]Effect{.Chorus, .Compressor, .Delay, .Distortion, .Eq, .Filter, .Flanger, .Phaser, .Reverb}
```

The order a chain starts in.

### CHAIN_DEFAULTS

```odin
CHAIN_DEFAULTS : Chain_Params : Chain_Params{order = CHAIN_ORDER, chorus = CHORUS_DEFAULTS, compressor = COMPRESSOR_DEFAULTS, delay = DELAY_DEFAULTS, distortion = DISTORTION_DEFAULTS, eq = EQ_DEFAULTS, filter = {filter = FILTER_DEFAULTS}, flanger = FLANGER_DEFAULTS, phaser = PHASER_DEFAULTS, reverb = REVERB_DEFAULTS}
```

Every effect off, each at its defaults, in `CHAIN_ORDER`.

### TEMPO_RATIOS

```odin
TEMPO_RATIOS : [13]f32 : [13]f32{0, 1.0 / 128, 1.0 / 64, 1.0 / 32, 1.0 / 16, 1.0 / 8, 1.0 / 4, 1.0 / 2, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16}
```

Tempo divisions effects sync to (an index), as cycles a beat: 0 is
frozen, then 32 bars ... 1/64.

### FX_GRID

```odin
FX_GRID :: 32
```

Samples between the control points of the effects that sweep (delay,
chorus, flanger): on a grid of their own, so a block's size never
moves one.

### COMB_SIZE

```odin

```

Samples of delay a comb can hold (a side): enough for the lowest
cutoff (key 8, 13.75 Hz) at 48 kHz.

### COMB_STYLES

```odin

```

Comb styles (`Filter_Params.style` for the Comb model): feedback (comb,
a positive flange, a negative flange) by filter (a low/high blend, or a
band whose width the blend sets).

## Types

### Effect

```odin
Effect :: enum u8 {
	Chorus,
	Compressor,
	Delay,
	Distortion,
	Eq,
	Filter,
	Flanger,
	Phaser,
	Reverb,
}
```

The effects a chain has.

### Chain_Params

```odin
Chain_Params :: struct {
	order: [9]Effect,
	on: bit_set[Effect],
	chorus: Chorus_Params,
	compressor: Compressor_Params,
	delay: Delay_Params,
	distortion: Distortion_Params,
	eq: Eq_Params,
	filter: Filter_Fx_Params,
	flanger: Flanger_Params,
	phaser: Phaser_Params,
	reverb: Reverb_Params,
}
```

A chain's settings: the order, which are on, and each one's own.

### Chain

```odin
Chain :: struct {
	chorus: Chorus,
	compressor: Compressor,
	delay: Delay,
	distortion: Distortion,
	eq: Eq,
	filter: Filter_Fx,
	flanger: Flanger,
	phaser: Phaser,
	reverb: Reverb,
	was_on: bit_set[Effect],
}
```

A chain's state: every effect's (made with `chain_make`).

### Line

```odin
Line :: struct {
	buf: []f32,
	mask: int,
	at: int,
}
```

A delay line a side (or a voice): written a sample at a time, read
`past` samples back (2 or more), cubically between samples. Its length
is a power of two. Made with `line_make`.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `buf` |  |
| `mask` |  |
| `at` | where the next sample goes |

### Sync

```odin
Sync :: enum u8 {
	Free,
	Tempo,
	Dotted,
	Triplet,
}
```

How a rate is set: free (in Hz), or to the tempo (straight, dotted or
triplet).

### Line4

```odin
Line4 :: struct {
	buf: []#simd[4]f32,
	mask: int,
	at: int,
	max: #simd[4]f32,
}
```

Four delay lines written together, interleaved: a sample of each at
every place, so a write is one vector. Each reads as the `Line`
`line_make` would have made it (the same longest delay), the buffer as
long as the longest's. The reverb's rows.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `buf` |  |
| `mask` |  |
| `at` |  |
| `max` | each line's `line_max` |

### Distortion_Type

```odin
Distortion_Type :: enum u8 {
	Soft_Clip,
	Hard_Clip,
	Linear_Fold,
	Sine_Fold,
	Bit_Crush,
	Down_Sample,
}
```

What a distortion does to the signal.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `Soft_Clip` | tanh |
| `Hard_Clip` | clipped at ±1 |
| `Linear_Fold` | folded back in straight lines |
| `Sine_Fold` | folded through a sine |
| `Bit_Crush` | steps |
| `Down_Sample` | held for longer, the lower the drive |

### Filter_Order

```odin
Filter_Order :: enum u8 {
	None,
	Pre,
	Post,
}
```

Where a distortion's filter is.

### Distortion_Params

```odin
Distortion_Params :: struct {
	type: Distortion_Type,
	drive_db: f32,
	mix: f32,
	order: Filter_Order,
	cutoff: f32,
	resonance: f32,
	blend: f32,
}
```

A distortion's settings.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `type` |  |
| `drive_db` | -30..30 |
| `mix` | 0..1 |
| `order` |  |
| `cutoff` | a key |
| `resonance` |  |
| `blend` | 0 low .. 1 band .. 2 high |

### Distortion

```odin
Distortion :: struct {
	held: [2]f32,
	count: [2]f32,
	filter: Filter_State,
	last_mix: f32,
	set: bool,
}
```

A distortion's state.

### Delay_Style

```odin
Delay_Style :: enum u8 {
	Mono,
	Stereo,
	Ping_Pong,
	Mid_Ping_Pong,
}
```

How a delay's two sides play.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `Mono` | the same time both sides |
| `Stereo` | a time each side |
| `Ping_Pong` | the input summed, bouncing side to side |
| `Mid_Ping_Pong` | each side's own, bouncing |

### Delay_Params

```odin
Delay_Params :: struct {
	style: Delay_Style,
	wet: f32,
	feedback: f32,
	hz: [2]f32,
	cutoff: f32,
	spread: f32,
}
```

A delay's settings.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `style` |  |
| `wet` | 0..1 |
| `feedback` | -1..1 |
| `hz` | repeats a second, left and right (from its time or the tempo) |
| `cutoff` | a key: the centre of the feedback's band |
| `spread` | 0..1: how wide that band is (0: a narrow band, 1: eight octaves) |

### Delay

```odin
Delay :: struct {
	lines: [2]Line,
	period: [2]f32,
	freq: [2]f32,
	poles: [2][4]f32,
	from: [9]f32,
	to: [9]f32,
	tick: int,
	set: bool,
}
```

A delay's state: its lines and filters, and its settings at the last
two control points (`FX_GRID` samples apart), glided between.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `lines` |  |
| `period` |  |
| `freq` | the rate it is moving to the set one, smoothed |
| `poles` |  |
| `from` |  |
| `to` | wet, dry, feedback L, feedback R, low g, high g, gain, period L, period R |
| `tick` | where it is between control points |
| `set` |  |

### Chorus_Params

```odin
Chorus_Params :: struct {
	voices: int,
	hz: f32,
	feedback: f32,
	wet: f32,
	cutoff: f32,
	spread: f32,
	depth: f32,
	delay: [2]f32,
}
```

A chorus's settings.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `voices` | pairs of delays: 1..4 |
| `hz` | the modulation's rate |
| `feedback` | -0.95..0.95 |
| `wet` |  |
| `cutoff` | a key |
| `spread` | 0..1 |
| `depth` | 0..1 (up to 30 ms of sweep) |
| `delay` | seconds: the two delays each pair is spread between |

### Chorus

```odin
Chorus :: struct {
	delays: [8]Delay,
	lines: [2][2]Line4,
	active: int,
	phase: f32,
	hz: [8][2]f32,
	from: [2]f32,
	to: [2]f32,
	tick: int,
	set: bool,
}
```

A chorus's state: a delay a side for each of its voices (two a pair).

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `delays` | their state (not their lines) |
| `lines` | the delays' lines, four delays a group, a side each (delay 4g + j: lane j) |
| `active` | delays that ran last (a delay switched on starts clean) |
| `phase` |  |
| `hz` | each delay's rate since the last control point |
| `from` |  |
| `to` | wet, dry |
| `tick` |  |
| `set` |  |

### Flanger_Params

```odin
Flanger_Params :: struct {
	hz: f32,
	center: f32,
	feedback: f32,
	wet: f32,
	depth: f32,
	offset: f32,
}
```

A flanger's settings.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `hz` | its sweep's rate |
| `center` | a key: the comb's centre (its delay's pitch) |
| `feedback` | -1..1 |
| `wet` | 0..0.5 (0.5: as much flanged as dry) |
| `depth` | 0..1 |
| `offset` | 0..1: the right side's sweep ahead of the left's |

### Flanger

```odin
Flanger :: struct {
	delay: Delay,
	phase: f32,
	hz: [2]f32,
	tick: int,
}
```

A flanger's state.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `delay` |  |
| `phase` |  |
| `hz` | its delay's rate since the last control point |
| `tick` |  |

### Phaser_Params

```odin
Phaser_Params :: struct {
	hz: f32,
	feedback: f32,
	wet: f32,
	center: f32,
	blend: f32,
	depth: f32,
	offset: f32,
}
```

A phaser's settings.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `hz` | its sweep's rate |
| `feedback` | 0..1 |
| `wet` | 0..1 |
| `center` | a key |
| `blend` | 0..2: one, three or five peaks |
| `depth` | semitones the sweep reaches either way (0..48) |
| `offset` | 0..1: the sides' sweeps apart |

### Phaser

```odin
Phaser :: struct {
	filters: [2]Filter_State,
	phase: f32,
	last_mix: f32,
	set: bool,
}
```

A phaser's state.

### Eq_Mode

```odin
Eq_Mode :: enum u8 {
	Shelf,
	Cut,
}
```

What an EQ band is.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `Shelf` | the low and high bands: a shelf; the middle one: a bell |
| `Cut` | the low band: a high-pass; the middle: a notch; the high: a low-pass |

### Eq_Band

```odin
Eq_Band :: struct {
	mode: Eq_Mode,
	cutoff: f32,
	gain_db: f32,
	resonance: f32,
}
```

An EQ band's settings.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `mode` |  |
| `cutoff` | a key |
| `gain_db` | -15..15 (a shelf's or bell's) |
| `resonance` | 0..1 |

### Eq_Params

```odin
Eq_Params :: struct {
	bands: [3]Eq_Band,
}
```

An EQ's settings: three bands, low to high.

### Eq

```odin
Eq :: struct {
	filters: [3]Filter_State,
}
```

An EQ's state.

### Filter_Fx_Params

```odin
Filter_Fx_Params :: struct {
	filter: Filter_Params,
}
```

The filter effect's settings: any filter model, its mix included.

### Filter_Fx

```odin
Filter_Fx :: struct {
	filter: Filter_State,

```

The filter effect's state.

### Compressor_Bands

```odin
Compressor_Bands :: enum u8 {
	Three,
	Low_Band,
	Band_High,
	One,
}
```

Which bands a compressor splits into.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `Three` | low (under 120 Hz), band, high (over 2.5 kHz) |
| `Low_Band` | low and the rest |
| `Band_High` | up to 2.5 kHz, and above |
| `One` | all as one |

### Compressor_Band

```odin
Compressor_Band :: struct {
	upper_db: f32,
	lower_db: f32,
	upper_ratio: f32,
	lower_ratio: f32,
	gain_db: f32,
}
```

One band's settings: above the upper threshold it is pressed down by
the upper ratio; below the lower threshold it is raised (a positive
ratio) or pushed further down (negative); then its gain.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `upper_db` |  |
| `lower_db` | -80..0 |
| `upper_ratio` | 0..1 |
| `lower_ratio` | -1..1 |
| `gain_db` | -30..30 |

### Compressor_Params

```odin
Compressor_Params :: struct {
	bands: Compressor_Bands,
	band: [3]Compressor_Band,
	attack: f32,
	release: f32,
	mix: f32,
}
```

A compressor's settings.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `bands` |  |
| `band` | low, band, high |
| `attack` | 0..1 (each band's own times, scaled by e^(8x-4)) |
| `release` | 0..1 |
| `mix` |  |

### Filter_Model

```odin
Filter_Model :: enum u8 {
	Analog,
	Dirty,
	Ladder,
	Digital,
	Diode,
	Formant,
	Comb,
	Phaser,
}
```

A synth voice's filter: one of eight models, each with styles, a
cutoff (as a key, so modulation moves it in semitones), resonance,
drive and a blend between its responses.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `Analog` | a Sallen-Key: two resonant poles (12 dB) or four (24 dB), driven into tanh |
| `Dirty` | the analog's poles saturating inside the loop |
| `Ladder` | four saturating poles with global feedback |
| `Digital` | a clean state-variable filter |
| `Diode` | a diode ladder: high-pass before, a nastier resonance |
| `Formant` | four band-passes on a vowel's formants, moved by X and Y |
| `Comb` | a tuned delay: combs and flangers |
| `Phaser` | all-pass stages with resonance: peaks or notches |

### Filter_Style

```odin
Filter_Style :: enum u8 {
	Db12,
	Db24,
	Notch_Pass_Swap,
	Dual_Notch_Band,
	Band_Peak_Notch,
	Shelving,
}
```

A style: how the model is wired. Not every model has every style; each
says which it takes (see `filter_styles`).

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `Db12` | 12 dB: low, band and high by the blend |
| `Db24` | 24 dB |
| `Notch_Pass_Swap` | low-pass to notch to high-pass |
| `Dual_Notch_Band` | two notches, the blend moving them |
| `Band_Peak_Notch` | band-pass to peak to notch |
| `Shelving` | low shelf, peak, high shelf (Digital) |

### Filter_Params

```odin
Filter_Params :: struct {
	model: Filter_Model,
	style: Filter_Style,
	cutoff: f32,
	resonance: f32,
	drive_db: f32,
	blend: f32,
	mix: f32,
	gain_db: f32,
	formant_x: f32,
	formant_y: f32,
	formant_transpose: f32,
	formant_resonance: f32,
	formant_spread: f32,
	comb_offset: f32,
	mono: bool,
	clean: bool,
}
```

What a filter does for one render (modulated, in its working units).

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `model` |  |
| `style` |  |
| `cutoff` | as a key (8..136; 60 is middle C) |
| `resonance` | 0..1 |
| `drive_db` | 0..20 |
| `blend` | 0..2: low (0), band (1), high (2) for most styles |
| `mix` | 0..1: the dry signal against the filtered |
| `gain_db` | shelving: the shelf's gain |
| `formant_x` |  |
| `formant_y` | 0..1: the vowel (Formant) |
| `formant_transpose` | semitones |
| `formant_resonance` | 0.3..1 |
| `formant_spread` | -1..1 |
| `comb_offset` | semitones the second comb sits above (0..84) |
| `mono` | the first side only (the second left as it is) |
| `clean` | Phaser: resonance through tanh, the input not clipped |

### Filter_State

```odin
Filter_State :: struct {
	model: Filter_Model,
	set: bool,
	poles: [2][24]f32,
	extra: [2][4]f32,
	last: Filter_Coeffs,
	formant: Formant_State,
	comb: Comb_State,
	phaser: Phaser_State,
}
```

One filter of one voice: its model's state, a side each, and the
coefficients it glides from. Zero it to reset.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `model` | the model the state is for (a new one resets it) |
| `set` |  |
| `poles` | The analog family's poles (Analog, Dirty: two pre, two main; Ladder, Diode: four; Digital: two integrators), a side each. |
| `extra` |  |
| `last` |  |
| `formant` |  |
| `comb` |  |
| `phaser` |  |

### Formant_State

```odin
Formant_State :: struct {
	ic: [2][4][2]f32,
	last: [4][3]f32,
}
```

A formant filter's state: four state-variable filters a side, and the
settings it glides from.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `ic` |  |
| `last` | each formant's key, damping, gain |

### Comb_State

```odin
Comb_State :: struct {
	memory: [2][4096]f32,
	at: int,
	poles: [2][4]f32,
	last: [6]f32,
}
```

A comb's state: its delay lines, its two filters a side, and the
settings it glides from.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `memory` |  |
| `at` |  |
| `poles` |  |
| `last` | feedback, scale, coefficient 1, coefficient 2, low gain, high gain |

### Phaser_State

```odin
Phaser_State :: struct {
	stages: [2][12][2]f32,
	clean: [2][4]f32,
	feedback: [2]f32,
	last: [5]f32,
}
```

A phaser's state: twelve all-pass stages a side, two filters that
keep its feedback in a band, and its last output.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `stages` |  |
| `clean` |  |
| `feedback` |  |
| `last` | resonance, drive, peak 1, peak 3, peak 5 |

### Follower_Params

```odin
Follower_Params :: struct {
	attack_ms: f32,
	release_ms: f32,
	hold: bool,
	sample_hold: bool,
	division: int,
}
```

What an envelope follower does.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `attack_ms` | how fast it rises (0.1..100) |
| `release_ms` | how fast it falls (1..3000) |
| `hold` | it stays at its peak while the level is above half of it (a drum's whole body, not just its click) |
| `sample_hold` | its value is taken at each `division` and held (steps, in time) |
| `division` | the sample-and-hold's rate: an index into `TEMPO_RATIOS` (1..12; 10 is 1/16) |

### Follower

```odin
Follower :: struct {...}
```

An envelope follower's state. Zero is ready to run. Fields are internal.

### Beat_Clock

```odin
Beat_Clock :: struct {
	playing: bool,
	beat: f64,
	beats_per_frame: f64,
	bar_beats: f64,
	started: bool,
}
```

Where a render sits on the transport: what an LFO synced to the tempo,
a retrigger, or a sample-and-hold reckons from.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `playing` | the transport plays |
| `beat` | the timeline beat at the render's first frame |
| `beats_per_frame` | tempo / 60 / sample rate: how far a frame moves (also while stopped: the synced rates still run) |
| `bar_beats` | beats a bar (4 in 4/4; 0 is taken as 4) |
| `started` | play started at the render's first frame |

### Lfo_Wave

```odin
Lfo_Wave :: enum u8 {
	Sine,
	Triangle,
	Ramp_Up,
	Ramp_Down,
	Square,
	Random_Steps,
	Random_Smooth,
}
```

An LFO's wave.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `Sine` |  |
| `Triangle` |  |
| `Ramp_Up` |  |
| `Ramp_Down` |  |
| `Square` |  |
| `Random_Steps` | a new random value each cycle |
| `Random_Smooth` | random values each cycle, eased from one to the next |

### Lfo_Mode

```odin
Lfo_Mode :: enum u8 {
	Hz,
	Sync,
	Dotted,
	Triplet,
	Sixteenths,
}
```

How an LFO's rate is set: in Hz; a tempo division, straight, dotted or
triplet (`division`); or a whole number of sixteenths a cycle.

### Lfo_Retrigger

```odin
Lfo_Retrigger :: enum u8 {
	Off,
	Beat,
	Bar,
	Play,
}
```

What restarts an LFO's cycle: nothing; each beat; each bar; play
starting. (Synced and playing, Off follows the timeline from beat 0.)

### Lfo_Stereo

```odin
Lfo_Stereo :: enum u8 {
	Phase,
	Spin,
}
```

How an LFO's right side differs from its left: by a fixed phase, or by
a faster rate (they drift apart and back).

### Lfo_Params

```odin
Lfo_Params :: struct {
	wave: Lfo_Wave,
	morph: f32,
	mode: Lfo_Mode,
	hz: f32,
	division: int,
	sixteenths: int,
	stereo: Lfo_Stereo,
	phase_deg: f32,
	spin_hz: f32,
	offset_deg: f32,
	retrigger: Lfo_Retrigger,
	smooth: f32,
}
```

What an LFO does.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `wave` |  |
| `morph` | 0..1, 0.5 plain: the skew (Sine, Triangle), the curve (the ramps), the pulse width (Square), the glide (Random_Steps) |
| `mode` |  |
| `hz` | the rate in Hz mode (0.01..40) |
| `division` | Sync, Dotted, Triplet: an index into `TEMPO_RATIOS` (1..12; 10 is 1/16) |
| `sixteenths` | Sixteenths: a cycle's length (1..64) |
| `stereo` |  |
| `phase_deg` | Phase: the right side ahead of the left (0..360) |
| `spin_hz` | Spin: the right side faster by this (0..2) |
| `offset_deg` | both sides' start in the cycle (0..360) |
| `retrigger` |  |
| `smooth` | 0..1: a one-pole after the wave, up to a quarter cycle |

### Lfo

```odin
Lfo :: struct {...}
```

An LFO's state: where each side is in its cycle. Zero is ready to run.
Fields are internal.

### Sf_Type

```odin
Sf_Type :: enum u8 {
	Low,
	High,
	Band,
	Notch,
	Peak,
	Morph,
	DJ,
	Comb,
	Vowel,
	Phaser,
}
```

SuperFilter's filter types.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `Low` |  |
| `High` |  |
| `Band` |  |
| `Notch` |  |
| `Peak` |  |
| `Morph` | low → band → high → notch as Morph goes 0 → 1 |
| `DJ` | one knob: Freq under its middle a low-pass coming down, over it a high-pass going up, flat between |
| `Comb` | a tuned comb: Morph is its feedback, negative to positive |
| `Vowel` | formants: Morph moves through the vowels (A O E I), Freq transposes them (1 kHz: as they are) |
| `Phaser` | all-pass stages: Morph blends their peaks |

### Sf_Circuit

```odin
Sf_Circuit :: enum u8 {
	Clean,
	Analog,
	Dirty,
	Ladder,
	Diode,
}
```

SuperFilter's circuits: the voicing of the types made of poles (Low,
High, Band, Notch, Peak, Morph, DJ). Clean is a state-variable filter
(its 24 dB two in a row); the others saturate.

### Super_Filter_Settings

```odin
Super_Filter_Settings :: struct {
	timeline: core.Timeline_Id,
}
```

Settings for `super_filter_create`.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `timeline` | the timeline synced rates follow (zero: the transport's leader) |

### Super_Filter_Readout

```odin
Super_Filter_Readout :: struct {
	cutoff_hz: [2]f32,
	lfo: [2]f32,
	env: f32,
	in_peak: f32,
	out_peak: f32,
}
```

What a SuperFilter is doing, for drawing it (`super_filter_readout`).

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `cutoff_hz` | the modulated cutoff, each side, at the end of the last block |
| `lfo` | the LFO, each side (-1..1) |
| `env` | the envelope (0..1) |
| `in_peak` | the last block's peak in (linear) |
| `out_peak` | and out |

### Super_Filter_Values

```odin
Super_Filter_Values :: [31]f32
```

A SuperFilter's settings, by parameter id (index 0 unused).

### Super_Filter

```odin
Super_Filter :: struct {
	settings: Super_Filter_Settings,
	values: [31]f32,
	sample_rate: f64,
	frame: i64,
	fill: int,
	gathered: [4][32]f32,
	done: [2][32]f32,
	piece_clock: Beat_Clock,
	lfo: Lfo,
	follower: Follower,
	filters: ^[2][2]Filter_State,
	scratch: [8][]f32,
	glide: [3]f32,
	glide_set: bool,
	readout: [7]u32,
	pending: [64]Sf_Change,
	pending_n: int,
	allocator: mem.Allocator,
}
```

A SuperFilter node's state (from `super_filter_create`). Fields are
internal.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `settings` |  |
| `values` |  |
| `sample_rate` |  |
| `frame` | frames taken in since the last reset (its 32-frame pieces line up with these) |
| `fill` | frames of the piece being gathered |
| `gathered` | the piece coming in: left, right, key left, key right |
| `done` | the last piece, filtered: what goes out while the next comes in |
| `piece_clock` | the clock at the gathered piece's first frame |
| `lfo` |  |
| `follower` |  |
| `filters` | a side each; the second for Clean at 24 dB |
| `scratch` | lfo l, lfo r, env, cut l, cut r, dry l, dry r, key |
| `glide` | freq (a key), output gain, mix: where the last frame left them |
| `glide_set` |  |
| `readout` | atomics: a `Super_Filter_Readout`'s floats, as bits |
| `pending` | changes waiting for their piece (oldest first) |
| `pending_n` |  |
| `allocator` |  |

## Procedures

### chain_make

```odin
chain_make :: proc(c: ^Chain, max_rate: f64, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator, only: bit_set[Effect] = ~bit_set[Effect]{}) -> core.Error
```

Control thread. Makes the effects' lines for rates up to `max_rate`
(only those of `only`: an effect without its lines renders nothing).

### chain_destroy

```odin
chain_destroy :: proc(c: ^Chain, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator)
```

Control thread. Frees a chain's lines.

### chain_order_valid

```odin
chain_order_valid :: proc "contextless"(order: [9]Effect) -> bool
```

Whether `order` holds each effect once.

### chain_reset

```odin
chain_reset :: proc "contextless"(c: ^Chain, e: Effect)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Silences effect `e` (its lines cleared, its state as new).

### chain_render

```odin
chain_render :: proc "contextless"(c: ^Chain, p: ^Chain_Params, l: []f32, r: []f32, sample_rate: f64, key_l: []f32 = nil, key_r: []f32 = nil)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Runs the effects that are on over `l` and `r` in place, in order.
A key (`key_l`, `key_r`) is the compressor's sidechain.

### line_make

```odin
line_make :: proc(frames: int, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator) -> (l: Line, err: core.Error)
```

Control thread. A delay line holding at least `frames` samples.

### line_destroy

```odin
line_destroy :: proc(l: ^Line, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator)
```

Control thread. Frees a delay line.

### line_max

```odin
line_max :: proc "contextless"(l: ^Line) -> f32
```

The longest delay a line can be read at (samples).

### line_clear

```odin
line_clear :: proc "contextless"(l: ^Line)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Clears a line.

### line_push

```odin
line_push :: proc "contextless"(l: ^Line, x: f32)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Writes the next sample.

### line_read

```odin
line_read :: proc "contextless"(l: ^Line, past: f32) -> f32
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). The sample `past` samples back from the last written (2 ..
line_max), with a Catmull-Rom cubic between samples.

### equal_power

```odin
equal_power :: proc "contextless"(t: f32) -> (wet: f32, dry: f32)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Equal-power fade: the wet gain at `t` (0..1) and the dry gain.

### clip_large

```odin
clip_large :: proc "contextless"(x: f32) -> f32
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). A soft-knee clip of large values (straight to ±8 × 0.66, then
tanh): what a feedback loop is held by.

### sync_hz

```odin
sync_hz :: proc "contextless"(sync: Sync, hz: f32, tempo: int, bpm: f64) -> f32
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). A rate in Hz: `hz` free, else tempo division `tempo` at `bpm`.

### distortion_render

```odin
distortion_render :: proc "contextless"(d: ^Distortion, p: ^Distortion_Params, l: []f32, r: []f32, sample_rate: f64)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Distorts `l` and `r` in place (the filter before or after, then
mixed with the dry signal).

### delay_make

```odin
delay_make :: proc(d: ^Delay, max_rate: f64, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator) -> core.Error
```

Control thread. A delay for rates up to `max_rate` Hz.

### delay_destroy

```odin
delay_destroy :: proc(d: ^Delay, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator)
```

Control thread. Frees a delay's lines.

### delay_render

```odin
delay_render :: proc "contextless"(d: ^Delay, p: ^Delay_Params, l: []f32, r: []f32, sample_rate: f64)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Runs the delay over `l` and `r` in place.

### chorus_make

```odin
chorus_make :: proc(c: ^Chorus, max_rate: f64, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator) -> core.Error
```

Control thread. A chorus for sample rates up to `max_rate`.

### chorus_destroy

```odin
chorus_destroy :: proc(c: ^Chorus, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator)
```

Control thread. Frees a chorus's lines.

### chorus_render

```odin
chorus_render :: proc "contextless"(c: ^Chorus, p: ^Chorus_Params, l: []f32, r: []f32, sample_rate: f64)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Runs the chorus over `l` and `r` in place: each voice a pair of
delays swept by a sine (the sides a quarter cycle apart, the pairs
spread across it), their times spread between the two set, summed.

### flanger_make

```odin
flanger_make :: proc(f: ^Flanger, max_rate: f64, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator) -> core.Error
```

Control thread. A flanger for sample rates up to `max_rate`.

### flanger_destroy

```odin
flanger_destroy :: proc(f: ^Flanger, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator)
```

Control thread. Frees a flanger's lines.

### flanger_render

```odin
flanger_render :: proc "contextless"(f: ^Flanger, p: ^Flanger_Params, l: []f32, r: []f32, sample_rate: f64)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Runs the flanger over `l` and `r` in place: a short delay (its
pitch the centre) swept by a triangle, fed back.

### phaser_render

```odin
phaser_render :: proc "contextless"(ph: ^Phaser, p: ^Phaser_Params, l: []f32, r: []f32, sample_rate: f64)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Runs the phaser over `l` and `r` in place: the phaser filter, its
centre swept by a triangle (the sides apart by the offset), mixed.

### eq_filter

```odin
eq_filter :: proc "contextless"(band: int, b: Eq_Band) -> Filter_Params
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). The filter an EQ band is.

### eq_render

```odin
eq_render :: proc "contextless"(e: ^Eq, p: ^Eq_Params, l: []f32, r: []f32, sample_rate: f64)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Runs the EQ over `l` and `r` in place.

### filter_fx_render

```odin
filter_fx_render :: proc "contextless"(f: ^Filter_Fx, p: ^Filter_Fx_Params, l: []f32, r: []f32, sample_rate: f64)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Runs the filter effect over `l` and `r` in place.

### compressor_render

```odin
compressor_render :: proc "contextless"(c: ^Compressor, p: ^Compressor_Params, l: []f32, r: []f32, sample_rate: f64, key_l: []f32 = nil, key_r: []f32 = nil)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Runs the compressor over `l` and `r` in place. With a key
(`key_l`, `key_r`, as long as `l`), each band's level is the key's band
instead of its own (a sidechain), and it only presses down.

### reverb_make

```odin
reverb_make :: proc(rv: ^Reverb, max_rate: f64, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator) -> core.Error
```

Control thread. A reverb for sample rates up to `max_rate`.

### reverb_destroy

```odin
reverb_destroy :: proc(rv: ^Reverb, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator)
```

Control thread. Frees a reverb's lines.

### reverb_render

```odin
reverb_render :: proc "contextless"(rv: ^Reverb, p: ^Reverb_Params, l: []f32, r: []f32, sample_rate: f64)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Runs the reverb over `l` and `r` in place: the input band-passed,
diffused through an all-pass per line, into sixteen delays that feed
each other (an orthogonal mix: a quarter of all, less half the line's
row and column of the 4 × 4), shelved and decayed so the tail falls 60 dB in
the decay time; their lengths scaled by the size and wandering with
the chorus; out through a pre-delay, the lines alternating sides.

### filter_render_side

```odin
filter_render_side :: proc "contextless"(f: ^Filter_State, p: ^Filter_Params, cutoff: []f32, buf: []f32, sample_rate: f64)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Filters one side, `buf`, in place (its cutoffs in `cutoff`).

### key_to_hz

```odin
key_to_hz :: proc "contextless"(key: f32) -> f32
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). The key a frequency is (key 69 is 440 Hz).

### filter_render

```odin
filter_render :: proc "contextless"(f: ^Filter_State, p: ^Filter_Params, cutoff: []f32, in_: ^[2][]f32, out: ^[2][]f32, sample_rate: f64)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Filters `in_` (a channel each) into `out` with `p`, per sample at
the cutoffs in `cutoff` (keys, one a sample: modulation is in them).
`out` may be `in_`. Settings glide from the last render's across this
one.

### follower_render

```odin
follower_render :: proc "contextless"(f: ^Follower, p: ^Follower_Params, clk: Beat_Clock, key: [2][]f32, out: []f32, sample_rate: f64)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Follows `key` (its sides together: the louder) into `out`
(0..1: `FOLLOWER_RANGE_DB` under full scale to full scale; the frames
as `key`'s), for clock `clk`. Allocates nothing.

### follower_level

```odin
follower_level :: proc "contextless"(level: f64) -> f32
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). A follower's output (0..1) for a linear level.

### lfo_render

```odin
lfo_render :: proc "contextless"(l: ^Lfo, p: ^Lfo_Params, clk: Beat_Clock, out: [2][]f32, sample_rate: f64)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Renders LFO `l` into `out` (its left and right sides, -1..1; the
right may be the left's slice, then the left is written), for clock
`clk`. Allocates nothing.

### lfo_cycles_per_beat

```odin
lfo_cycles_per_beat :: proc "contextless"(p: ^Lfo_Params) -> f64
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Cycles a beat LFO settings `p` run at (0 in Hz mode).

### super_filter_defaults

```odin
super_filter_defaults :: proc "contextless"() -> (v: [31]f32)
```

SuperFilter's settings at their defaults.

### super_filter_impulse

```odin
super_filter_impulse :: proc(v: ^[31]f32, out: []f32, sample_rate: f64, at_hz: f32 = 0) -> (base_hz: f32, anchor_hz: f32)
```

Control thread. The response of SuperFilter's filter stage at settings
`v`, unmodulated: its impulse into `out` (an impulse of 0.25: the
circuits that drive stay near their small-signal selves), with DJ's
fade, the output gain and Dry/Wet (the clip left out), rendered at
cutoff `at_hz` (0: its own). Returns its own cutoff (`base_hz`: the
readout's `cutoff_hz` unmodulated) and the cutoff the shape rendered
sits at (`anchor_hz`): the response at a modulated cutoff `c` is this
one moved along the frequencies by `c / anchor_hz` (Vowel's formants
follow no cutoff: its anchor is its own).

### super_filter_create

```odin
super_filter_create :: proc(settings: Super_Filter_Settings, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator) -> (node: core.Node, sf: ^Super_Filter)
```

Control thread. A SuperFilter at its defaults. Add it to a graph with 2
inputs and 2 outputs, or 4 inputs (the last two a sidechain key) and 2
outputs.

### super_filter_readout

```odin
super_filter_readout :: proc "contextless"(sf: ^Super_Filter) -> Super_Filter_Readout
```

Any thread. What SuperFilter `sf` is doing (as of its last block).

### super_filter_circuit_has

```odin
super_filter_circuit_has :: proc "contextless"(c: Sf_Circuit, t: Sf_Type) -> bool
```

Whether circuit `c` makes type `t`. Diode makes Low only (it is a
four-pole low-pass, whatever its blend); Comb, Vowel and Phaser have no
circuit (any is "yes"). A type a circuit doesn't make plays on Analog.

### super_filter_has_slope

```odin
super_filter_has_slope :: proc "contextless"(c: Sf_Circuit, t: Sf_Type) -> bool
```

Whether the slope (12 or 24 dB) means anything for type `t` on circuit
`c`: Low, High, Band and Morph, but not on Diode (24 dB always).

### super_filter_params

super_filter_params: [30]core.Param_Info

Parameter table of the SuperFilter node, as `node_params` returns it.
Read-only.
